## Purpose
Trunk directory for GitHub-specific repo configuration. Today it only hosts the Actions CI definitions under `workflows/`.

## Subdirectories
- `workflows/` — GitHub Actions workflow definitions; owns the `tests` CI job that runs `npm test` on push/PR. See `workflows/README.md`.

## Dependencies / collaborators
- Root `package.json` — workflows here invoke `npm test`; the script name is the CI contract.
- `docgen.test.mjs` and hook tests under `tools/` — what CI actually exercises.

## Gotchas
- No files live directly in `.github/` — all CI logic is one level down in `workflows/`. Don't add new workflows here; put them in `workflows/`.
